trailhead.label: Tschirland village centre by the Tschirlander Hof, Citybus 264 stop Tschirlander Hof (official start)

cautions: About 1 km on the farm road out of Tschirland, open to cars.
A gate into the wooded pasture of the Tschirlander Hoad (km 2.9), where animals may graze.
A steeper woodland path between km 2 and 2.7.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
